attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Educational programs related to the practice of veterinary medicine sponsored or approved by the board (renewal form lists SDVMA annual meeting, other state meetings, approved CE)
rules.audit_note: Proof of attendance on board request; CE hours listed on the renewal form.
rules.notes: Rule: 16 hours annually; renewal form asks for 32 hours for the past two years. Registration renewed biennially before July 1 (current period July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2027). Hardship waiver possible.
